name: Starfield Grove
desc:
Starfield Grove is an area located within [Aratel Island](location:aratel_island), found to the left of the [Greathive Gate](location:the_starswept_valley), where you must hop on acid geisers to reach the entrance of the cave. Using the Ignition Hook near the entrance will lead you to the top of the Star Tree, where there is a static Stone Knight spawn as well as the spawn for Iblis, The Fallen Angel.

By taking an entrance through the [Bluster Rift](location:bluster_rift), you may find two threshers blocking your way. Here Stardust spawns at the root of the tree alongside any other Voidzones that contains a Star Tree located around the map. You can also find Skyvalor Flowers for Willpower Attribute Flasks.
additional_info: -   This area is one of three areas that contain a Star Tree, along with the [Starfield Veldt](location:starfield_veldt) and [Starfield Tundra](location:starfield_tundra).
